    Compare your setups

    A straighter line is not proof of a healthier spine or better sleep. Keep the photo conditions the same, and judge comfort over several nights.

    Your pillow fit profile

    Designed for comparison, not diagnosis

    SleepFit measures the outline of your back from points you mark on a photo (or from the iPhone 3D scan). It does not see bone position, diagnose a condition, or prescribe a mattress. Alignment targets are provisional and not yet validated. See a doctor or physiotherapist for persistent neck or back pain, numbness, tingling or pain that wakes you.

    SleepFit · Research prototype v0.2 · Photos and results stay on your device and are cleared when you close or refresh the page.
